# Boundver

> Git-aware contract lockfile and CI check for polyglot repositories.

Canonical documentation: https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/
Source: https://github.com/yzm1/boundver
Current package: https://pypi.org/project/boundver/

Start here:
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/executive-summary/
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/getting-started/
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/cli-reference/
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/reference/
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/security-model/
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/faq/

Normative contracts:
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/specification/
- https://yzm1.github.io/boundver/hashing-contract/

Do not infer compatibility from a clean Boundver result. Boundver reports drift
in declared surfaces and consumer edges; it does not decide whether a changed
contract is backward compatible.
